entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I hope you can help. I'm trying to return something, this VeloBand Pulse thing? But I think I'm too late. I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and the order number?
Sure, it's Maria Valenti. The order number is... um... VF789012.

Thank you, Maria. I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. So I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference issue?

Oh, I don't think it's broken. It's just... not what I expected. It's complicated. The real problem is, I tried to return it a long time ago, right after Christmas, but the website was all broken. Can't you just help me?
I understand your frustration. Can you tell me more about what happened when you tried to use the website? You said it was broken?

Yes! It was a complete website error. I filled out the form, but when I hit submit, it just spun and spun. The whole system seemed down. I couldn't print the return label or anything. I was so lost, I even took a screenshot of the error page.
Thank you for that detail, Maria. Let me just check our system logs for that period... Yes, it looks like we did have a known service outage that week. I'm very sorry you were impacted by that.
So... what does that mean? Am I stuck with it?

Not at all. Let me just pull up our return policy for you... Okay, I see here that all our items have a 90-day return window. Since your band was delivered 35 days ago, you are well within that timeframe.
Oh! Really? I thought I read somewhere it was shorter. That's such a relief!

No problem at all, I can process this return for you immediately. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. You should see a full refund within 5-7 business days after we receive it.
Wow, thank you so much, Isaac. You've been a huge help. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
